### Improved

- A border between two frames of the main window stops on a whole line: the line under it stays shown if at least half of it was visible.

### Fixed

- The list of the Fix software window always shows whole rows, like the lists of the main window.

## In version 3.0.0 (2026-11-10)

Changes since 2.0.0, where this repository starts.

### New

- Checks the JetBrains IDEs, Gateway, the Toolbox App and their background service.
- Updates a Python installed with the Python Install Manager or with uv, and a Deno installed with its own installer.
- Can replace the Node.js or the ssl files of the Python inside a program, after a backup. These fixes are not ticked by default.
- Gives the command that updates a certifi pinned by a Pipenv, Poetry or uv project.
- **Fix**, in the right-click menu of the lists, fixes the selected items.
- The Fix software window opens the detailed information with a double-click, sorts by column, and has the right-click menu.
- The PowerShell commands are shown in color.
- The report names the PC it was made on.

### Improved

- The detailed information is shorter, and opens in one window for several items.
- The console of the Fix software window shows the result of each command, with its warnings and errors in color.
- The fixes stop when a download or an update cannot reach its server.
- A software that is still not fixed after its fixes is unticked.
- The right-click menu says how many things each entry acts on.
- eMudScan no longer suggests updating everything with a package manager: only the software it found.
- A certificate bundle made by curl shows the date of its certificate data.

### Fixed

- No pip, pipx, uv or Scoop command where it cannot work.
- **Restore the backup** gives a file its original creation date back.
- Several homepages or searches open as tabs, in one start of the browser.
- The color codes in the output of some commands no longer appear as garbage.
- The summary of the certificate bundles is updated after fixes and restores.
